newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was inactive in the panhandle area late Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested at the close.

Feedlots reported moderate inquiry from buyers. 23,700 sales confirmed for the week to date which includes 22,000 head formulated and 300 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week. The last established price was 64.00 on Friday. Today's packer bids are mostly 63.00 with asking
